title: The Vector of New Lagos Again
author: Mirabel Voss
blurb: Rafael Halloran, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
